text: Sinead - new job @ Deloitte from Mon. ask how 1st wk went
Luca graduated! BSc physics, 2:1. parents flew in from Turin the day before. send congrats card
dry cleaning / pick up Thurs. also return Amazon parcel b4 5/14
Karan leaving the council after 11 yrs - last day Oct 31. leaving drinks @ the Crown that evening
Fern's little one starts reception Sept 4th. Fern v teary abt it, kid fine lol
remind me to ask Hamza how the promotion panel went - was Tues
Camila / pregnant again!! due March 9. her husband Juan wants it to be a surprise for the grandparents
car MOT due 11/2. book garage the week before

Gareth retiring after 30 yrs at the post office - last shift June 2nd. thinking surprise party June 3rd, the day after, at the cricket club? check w/ his wife first, she might have a holiday booked. he's been dropping hints abt wanting a proper fishing rod. could do a collection w/ the lads from 5 a side
Zara - GCSE results Aug 21. revised like mad, v nervous. text her that morning
Yaw's brother Karan got into Leeds for medicine. their mum over the moon
Tomás started @ the bakery. 4am starts, knackered already
Isla's dog Biscuit had op on leg, home now. Isla stressed re vet bills
Rohan + Demi - twins' first day @ nursery 9/8. Demi back at work the next day so Rohan doing drop off
don't forget: dentist 2:30 Fri, then pharmacy afterwards
Kevin - interview @ Barclays Weds. 2nd round. good luck text the night before
Barbara (Mrs MacDonald next door) - grandson graduating from Edinburgh July 1. she's going up by train the day before
Leah's leaving do cancelled - she's not leaving after all, got counter offer. promoted to team lead instead
Siddharth / Sid - finally passed driving test 3rd go!! wants to drive us to the coast
Hoang - new manager role starts after Xmas. promoted from within. buy him a decent pen? he's always borrowing mine
need to renew passport before May 14. photos @ Boots first
Alice's son sitting 11+ on Sept 12. Alice more nervous than him. ask her how it went a week after
Matteo - first day as junior dr Aug 7. ring him that evening, he'll need a pint
Reza says his dad's retiring from the taxi firm end of month. family meal the Sat after
Imani + Santiago - graduation ceremony May 19, both same day! joint party afterwards @ her parents'
Colm leaving Google, going freelance. starts own thing Jan. a bit scared tbh
bins Tues. recycling wk after. order new blue bin
Kerry - daughter's first day of secondary tomorrow. new uniform, new bus. text Kerry tomorrow eve to see how it went
Yosef got his PhD results - passed w/ minor corrections! viva was June 3rd, celebratory dinner that night
Katarzyna / Kasia starts new job @ Lidl HQ 5/27. said the commute's 90 mins each way
Laura's partner Tiago made redundant. she's holding it together but barely. must check in w/ her this wk
Demi - loves pottery, does Weds class. birthday next month, she mentioned a kiln course would be dreamy
Gareth Williams - brother-in-law of Kevin. ex-RAF. into model trains
grad ceremony tix for Sat - print. parking pass too. leave by 8
Luca's sister Fern - also graduating, nursing, Dec 12. ask Luca if family doing anything
Karan's last day was yday. card + flowers went down well. follow up abt new place, starts Nov 3rd
Sinead says her mum retiring from teaching after 40 yrs - assembly for her the morning of July 18th, party that eve
Hamza's boy Rohan - first day of school 9/3. Hamza dropping him off then straight to work. Hamza nervous abt it, Rohan isn't. little backpack w/ dinosaurs, already packed it twice
Hamza - promotion came thru! senior engineer. celebrate Fri

weekly shop / oat milk, bin bags, lightbulbs, birthday card x2, batteries for smoke alarm. Sun am before it gets busy. then return library books - overdue since 9/28 - and drop off the bag of clothes at the charity shop afterwards. car wash if time. meal prep Sun eve
Zara - got the grades. 3 A*s. sixth form app next. congrats msg
Tomás and Camila - their kid Isla lost first tooth lol. tooth fairy rates have gone up
Imani - started new job as paralegal 2 wks ago. loving it. boss Mrs Garcia v strict tho

Rohan - interview Tues 10am at the architecture firm, panel of 3 + a portfolio presentation. results Wed. he said he'd let me know the day after. text him Weds pm if nothing. he's been out of work since March so really needs this, sounded flat when we spoke. his wife Imani says he's barely eating

Leah's grad from Open Uni finally - 6 yrs part time while working nights at the hospital! ceremony Nov 22 in Manchester. her husband + kids going, her mum flying over from Dublin the day before. Leah says she'll cry the whole way through. send something nice that week - she's into gin, maybe that pink one
gym membership - cancel before 6/30 or charged another yr

Juan's daughter Demi sitting her A levels. first exam June 4th, last one June 26th, results Aug 13. he's more stressed than her - not sleeping, keeps quizzing her on chemistry at dinner. she wants Bristol, needs AAB. check in w/ Juan after the first one, and remind me to text Demi good luck the night before results
Santiago - quit the bank. retraining as electrician. course starts Feb

Isla - promoted to head of maths from Sept. said the HoD before her left a total mess, no schemes of work, two staff off long term sick. she's excited but worried she'll burn out. her partner Yosef says she's already working weekends. ask how the first term goes, maybe Oct half term, and take her for a coffee

Alice - her dad passed away Sunday, v sudden. funeral the 14th, which is the day before her son Tiago's graduation from Durham. awful timing, she said she's going to try and do both, drive up straight after the wake. her sister Laura handling the flowers. must send card + ring her the weekend after, once it's all over
Siddharth's wife Zara expecting! due 12/3. he's already panicking abt the car seat
Barbara - Uncle Colm's 80th, she's doing the cake. party Aug 2nd
Yaw - starts at Arsenal academy coaching role 7/15. massive. 1st session that afternoon
sort my own CV this wkend. apply for the Leeds role by Fri 10/24
Reza's farewell bbq Sat called off - rain. moved to the Sat after. bring chairs

Kevin got the Barclays job!! starts Monday, notice period done Fri. him and his gf Kerry moving to Canary Wharf the week after - flat viewing went well, signed already. Kerry not thrilled abt leaving Leeds, her whole family's up there. offered to help w/ the van that Sat. should get them a housewarming plant
Matteo Bianchi - neighbour's son. off to uni in Sept, Bristol, engineering. his mum already sad
Fern - her cat Pickle missing since Tues. leaflets up. text her tomorrow
Kerry Johnson - hates surprise parties. remember for her 40th next yr

Camila said Juan's work do went fine. his boss Hoang retiring in spring, Juan might go for his job. I should ask Juan nearer the time if he's applying. Camila keen, he's unsure. also their eldest Luca finishing primary school July 18 - leavers' assembly that morning, they want me there. need to book that day off
